retirement_reason: R1 modeled Lion's Eye Diamond with one creature payload only. LED discards the entire hand as an activation cost, so one activation can generate multiple simultaneous Hashaton triggers. R1 is insufficient for Phase B and is retired before qualification.
critical_corrections: Lion's Eye Diamond discards the controller's entire hand as an activation cost.
Each creature card discarded while Hashaton has its trigger ability creates its own trigger.
LED is a mana ability; after costs are paid, it resolves immediately without the stack before Hashaton triggers are stacked.
The controller orders simultaneous Hashaton triggers.
Countering one Hashaton trigger with Tishana's Tidebinder blanks Hashaton while Tidebinder remains, but sibling Hashaton triggers already on the stack remain independent.
Removing or blanking Hashaton does not erase already-created Hashaton triggers.
